suiteYaml:
version: 1
assertions:
  - id: no-ssn
    check: not_matches
    pattern: '\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}'
    flavor: re2
  - id: ticket
    check: matches
    pattern: 'TCK-\d{4}'
    flavor: re2
  - id: refund
    check: numeric_extract_compare
    pattern: 'refund of \$([0-9.]+)'
    op: lte
    value: 500
  - id: length
    check: length_between
    min: 40
    max: 800
verdict:
  fail_if: any
